name: Charts and drawings
author: Saeed
description: Draw curves (for example pump head-flow curves with the duty point), choose a pump from its curves, and draw a vertical section of a well installation. Saves SVG, or PNG when possible.

tools.name: plot
tools.description: Draw an X-Y chart and save it as .svg or .png. series: [{name, points:[[x,y],...], smooth?:'none'|'spline'|'poly2'|'poly3', axis?:'left'|'right', style?:'line'|'points'}]. markers: [{x,y,label}] such as the duty point. Use axis:'right' for a second scale (efficiency, power).

tools.name: system_curve
tools.description: Make the points of a system curve H = static + k*Q^2 that passes through the duty point (flow, head). Returns points to pass to plot.

tools.name: pump_select
tools.description: Choose pumps for a duty point. pumps: [{model, curve:[[Q,H],...], efficiency?:[[Q,percent],...], bepFlow?}]. A pump qualifies when its head at the duty flow is at least the required head (and not more than maxExcessPercent above it). Returns a ranked table (closest to the duty first).

tools.name: well_section
tools.description: Draw a vertical section of a well / borehole pump installation with dimensions (all depths in metres from ground level) and save it as .svg or .png.

dischargeHeight.description: Height of the discharge above ground.
